education.title: Education & Youth
education.hero_lead: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world. We provide access, tools, and mentorship.
education.challenge: Over 40% of youth in our target regions lack access to digital literacy training, leaving them behind in the modern economy.
education.solution: We build computer labs, train local teachers, and provide scholarships to ensure no child is left offline.
education.coordinator_quote: Seeing a child write their first line of code is not just about technology; it's about unlocking a future they didn't know existed.

health.title: Health & Wellness
health.hero_lead: Health is the foundation of all growth. Without it, education and economic progress stall.
health.challenge: Preventable diseases and lack of mental health support continue to ravage vulnerable communities.
health.solution: We deploy mobile clinics and train community health workers to provide last-mile care.
health.coordinator_quote: We treat patients, but we also heal communities by restoring their ability to work and learn.

economic-empowerment.title: Economic Empowerment
economic-empowerment.hero_lead: Charity is a band-aid; business is a cure. We build sustainable livelihoods.
economic-empowerment.challenge: Talent is universal, but opportunity is not. Many entrepreneurs lack the seed capital to start.
economic-empowerment.solution: We provide micro-grants and vocational training to turn ideas into income-generating businesses.
economic-empowerment.coordinator_quote: When a woman starts a business, the entire village eats.

social-integration.title: Social Integration
social-integration.hero_lead: Building bridges between cultures to foster belonging and reduce isolation.
social-integration.challenge: Refugees and migrants often face severe isolation, hindering their ability to contribute to society.
social-integration.solution: We create shared spaces for cultural exchange, language learning, and community building.
social-integration.coordinator_quote: A stranger is just a friend you haven't met yet. We create the meeting place.
